description_en: Update the instance type and scenario of a Database File System (DBFS) instance
description_zh: 修改一个数据库文件系统的实例规格和使用场景
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs update-dbfs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --fs-id dbfs-GOrr00000000Yd0VLOyBpg --used-scene MySQL_5.7 --instance-type dbfs.medium --advanced-features cpuCoreCount_:0.5,_memorySize_:512,_pageCacheSize_:128 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDbfs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the DBFS instance resides. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, see [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Database File System (DBFS) instance
parameters.name: fs_id

parameters.help_en:
The updated scenario. Valid values:

- MySQL 5.7

- PostgreSQL

- MongoDB

- Oracle RAC
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的使用场景。取值范围：

- MySQL 5.7

- PostgreSQL

- MongoDB

- Oracle RAC
parameters.name: used_scene

parameters.help_en:
The updated instance type. Valid values:

- dbfs.small

- dbfs.medium

- dbfs.large (default)
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的实例规格。取值范围：

- dbfs.small

- dbfs.medium

- dbfs.large（默认值）
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: Customize CPU core count, maximum memory size, and page cache size for the DBFS instance
parameters.help_zh: 可定制数据库文件存储实例使用的CPU核数、内存上限值等
parameters.name: advanced_features
